description: List users the caller can see in the connected product — id, name, email, username, status. Use this to resolve a person's NAME to a userId before filtering tc_list / story_list by `createdBy` / `updatedBy`. Non-admin callers are auto-scoped server-side to users in their assigned projects. Optional `search` matches on name (case-insensitive substring). Optional `projectId` narrows further to that project's members. Requires a live connection. Read-only.

projectId.description: Only users assigned to this project (from list_projects).

name: list_users
title: List users (resolve a name to a userId)
